arw_adder_season.accept_text:
Bring me adder glands, and whatever bruiseweed you can pull on the way. The weed grows along the road cuts - you will walk past it whether you are looking or not.

And keep the bruiseweed. I need to see it, not take it off you. I am not robbing people who do me favours, that is the Syndicate's business model.

arw_what_veska_hears.accept_text:
Bring me the charms, and I want them lifted where they lie so I can see which way each one faced. Do not go for the harbinger. She is not the question.

The question is why a village would spend a year listening to itself.

The charms hang in Witherbark Hollow, north-east across the moor, and the shadowcasters carry the rest.

arc_the_refuge_road.turn_in_text:
You've dealt with the maulers and the stone ones, and the road is a road again for about a fortnight.

I am not going to say I told them so. I am going to carry this report myself and put it in the Overlord's hand and stand there while he reads it.

arc_the_bound.accept_text:
Bring me their cores. They have a stone at the centre and it is not the same stone as the rest of them - it is ring stone, off the circles, and that is a fact I would like five of rather than one.

And go back to the fourth ring afterwards - the one east of here, below Hammerfall. Three of those circles are quiet. The fourth is not, and I want you to have the cores in your hand when you stand in it.

arc_the_mere.accept_text:
Bring me their bladders intact, and intact is the word that matters - they rupture if you are careless and what is inside them is the entire sample.

I am not asking you to be brave. I am asking you to be slow. Bravery has cost me two couriers and no data.

arc_the_silt_mother.accept_text:
I want pearls off the bed and a good look at what is in the middle.

Freshwater pearls. In a mere. Something down there is making them and making them in rows, and I would like very much to know whether the rows mean anything or whether I am a man who has been alone with a pond for too long.

arc_dry_the_brood.accept_text:
I want some of their shells and a look at the sump. I want the shells because a shell tells you the temperature it was laid at, and I want the sump because the sump is where the heat is coming from.

The Pick-Mother will be between you and both. I am sorry about that and I am going to ask you to do it anyway.

Drywhisker Deeps, in the gorge south-east of Hammerfall. The warm gallery is past the diggings.

arc_dry_below.turn_in_text:
They're offerings, and they were arranged, and arranged is a word I have been avoiding since the Envoy first used it about the pearls in the mere.

That is Drywhisker finished and it is not Arathi finished. Rest. Eat something. Then go east, and when you get to the coast find a bosun called Tidewright and tell him Hammerfall sent you.

are_wrack_drowned.turn_in_text:
Dese keepsakes, an' t'ree of dem I can name.

Dey went out to look for people. Dat is all dey did wrong. Go an' rest, an' den come back, because dere is one more watch on dis coast dat nobody relieved an' it is older dan dis one by a long way.

are_they_are_holding.accept_text:
Bring me their watch orders, off three different islands. I want to see whether the same hand wrote them.

If it is three captains improvising, they are squatters and we can wait them out. If it is one hand, there is a plan, and a plan has an object.

Start with Gallowmast Isle, east across the flats from the Landing. The other two crews will find you.

Start with Gallowmast Isle, east across the flats from the Landing. The other two crews will find you. The Wrackline bosuns carry the orders. Their gunners will be between you and the bosuns.

bst_the_lights_go_out.turn_in_text:
So it was swarmers in the wood. I thought so.

The hive used to stay on its own side. If they're coming this far for mushrooms, they're short of food, or there are more of them than there were.

I'll tell Captain Yrsa. She won't be pleased.

cb_snapper_season.turn_in_text:
These plates are as thick as slabs.

This bridge will outlast us all now, which was the aim.

cb_dewdrops_of_the_dream.turn_in_text:
You brought the drops back and didn't spill one.

Look at what it shows. No - look properly, once, and then put it down.

The sleeper is not alone. The Fang have his ear.

cb_fang_and_flame.turn_in_text:
Look, these shards fit together.

One seal. One hand.

It's time to name the hand, and I find I've known it for a while.

cr_arrows_south.turn_in_text:
These arrows came from the Crossroads. Let me guess - Ruka, and she told you not to say.

The fletching's crooked. It always is. I'll use every one.

Since you've walked this far: the thorn on both sides of this road is full of quilboar, and I've got a list.

fen_noble_signets.turn_in_text: Every one of these is from a different house. The Rear Guard will want these.

hbw_ram_horns.accept_text:
Bring me horns off the foothill rams and I'll have oil in the lamps by Thursday.

Understand what you're doing for me: I can write to Lordaeron and be answered in April, or I can send you up a hill. The Dark Lady gave us our freedom. Nobody thought to give us a supply line.

hbw_militia.accept_text:
Deal with the ones in the fields, and I want you to understand I've thought about this longer than it sounds.

They're farmers with billhooks and a grievance, and the grievance is fair - we are standing in their valley. But they've been measuring my gate for a month, and men who measure a gate are deciding something. I'd rather they decided it with ten fewer.

The Hillsbrad Fields, south-east of this tower. You will see the fences from the road.

hbe_ditch_samples.accept_text:
I need samples, and not jars of ditchwater, I can fill those myself. Take them off the worgs that drink there. Whatever is in that water is in their coats and their gut, and a creature that has been drinking it for a month is a better record of it than anything I could dip.

And before you ask: yes, I know what we do here. That's exactly why I want to be certain it isn't us. If it is, I'd rather find it than have a farmer find it.

hbe_route_card.turn_in_text:
These tallies are in six different hands, all from one ledger - and not one of those hands is Syndicate.

They were counting for somebody else. I do this work for a living and I did not know anyone else was doing it on my road.

nb_signal_horns.turn_in_text:
Those are their horns, so that's fewer calls for help.

That's a good day, and I don't get many.

razorhill_supply_run.accept_text: Bring back any crates you find along the western route. I'm not proud of how long I let this sit unclaimed - let's just say I've been busy - but money left on the ground is still money, and I'd rather it be mine.
razorhill_supply_run.turn_in_text: That's crates of pure profit I'd already written off. This is exactly the kind of margin that makes a bad week into a good one. Pleasure doing business, genuinely.

sep_wasp_stings.turn_in_text:
You got the stings and didn't get stung.

You have steadier hands than most, and most of the people I send have been dead long enough to stop shaking.

swf_salt_cart.accept_text:
Jixa wants her salt in Freewind Post and there is no cart, no bird and no road worth the word. There is you.

The west crossing goes past the Brine and the basilisks have the Brine. Those, and eyes - I sell the eyes to people who think they are lucky, and before you ask, no, and they buy them anyway.

Bring me barbs as well. Those actually work for what I say they do, which makes them the odd item on my table.

sps_hunter_pelts.description:
I want pelts, and clean ones.

And before you shrug and go - listen, because the difference matters and I'll not take a bag of ruined work. 'Diseased' is fine. Half the wolves in Silverpine are diseased and the fur comes off a diseased wolf perfectly well. 'Dissolving' is not fine. You'll know the difference the moment you put a knife in.

I'm making a cloak.

[He waits to see whether you'll ask.]

No. For somebody I used to know. That's the whole of the answer and you can take it or you can go and be useful somewhere else.

sps_pond_samples.accept_text: Bring me bladders off the bloated ones at the pond. Sealed, or you'll bring me nothing.

sps_ferry_crates.accept_text: Bring the crates off the pier, from under the deckhands. They're taken up to the Rear Guard.

sb_grubbs_ledger.accept_text: Bring me the pages off the overseers' satchels, and Grubb himself in the pit.
sb_grubbs_ledger.description:
Foreman Grubb Deepdelver has run this pit since before the Keep was built.

And he keeps a ledger.

Ore. Workers. Accidents - and I want you to notice that he counts the accidents, because a man who doesn't care is a man who doesn't write them down.

He counts everything. I've watched him stop a line, at cost, to get a figure right.

That's the whole reason I want those pages. A man who counts that carefully is a man who knows exactly what he's counting toward, and the number is in there somewhere even if the reason isn't.

Get the pages off the overseers' satchels - they carry the day's sheets up to him.

And Grubb himself, if he comes up for air.

He's stubborn. He's also paid by the cubic yard, which is the single most useful thing I've learned about him and tells you how he'll fight.

sb_mastiffs_at_the_gate.turn_in_text:
These dispatches are orders for the east gate.

The dwarves are digging in, which is a different thing from digging.

sb_cut_the_fuse.turn_in_text:
You brought the charges back, all intact.

I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone I said so, I've a reputation that took years.

stvc_zuljana_names.turn_in_text: These stones have four names on them, and the fourth one is not a name for the cave at all. It is a name for the water. And it is the same word the Gurbashi use for the sand on their arena floor - the exact same word, same two sounds, and one lot means a river and the other lot means a killing-ground. I have known both of those words my whole life and never once put them next to each other. Go and ask the gatehouse what they think they are saying.

stvc_zuljana_font.accept_text: I want the cords, and I want to know the chamber they're read in. Nothing else - leave the shrine alone, it is not ours and it is not yours. The spraywater will come at you in the Font because the Font is what they are made of; them will clear you a quarter of an hour to work in. Read nothing. Carry it. I will do the reading.

stn_what_the_wood_is_for.accept_text: They're battens, thin, dressed, cut to one length. If they are dressing boards they are not burning them, and you do not build with another camp's timber unless you have run out of your own. Get me off the Stonehand, and keep the thornback apes off your back while you do it. They come down the cutline for anything that smells of the camp, and my lumber smells of the camp all the way through.

stn_including_me.accept_text:
Camp stores. Went off the stair into the water back when the mangroves still came up to the wall, and the crocolisks moved in after, which is the only reason it is still down there. Bring me the bundles, and whatever's left dry inside them. Watch the toads more than the lizards. A toad out there does not look like anything at all until it is on you.

They went in at Mistvale Lagoon, south of our gate.

stn_the_long_haul.accept_text:
No roost in a morning's flight, fine. Then we go in one hop and we go far. Over the water, up the whole length of the coast, Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad. A wyvern that flies that does not eat on the way, it eats before, and that means pressed feed, the heavy blocks, boar fat and jungle grain beaten together until it goes hard. I need the blocks. The rootgrubbers give you the fat. The thornbacks will try to take it back off you, because they have been robbing my feed store since the day the store existed.

Rootgrubbers and thornbacks both keep to the Green Cut, east of the gate.

bb_thirty_one.accept_text: Bring me their brass tags, numbered and punched at the shoulder. Goblin consignment, so every head was a line in somebody's book and every line had a number against it. Bring me tags, and walk out to the far sand to do it, not the first palm. The ones near the water were turned over years ago. The ones at the end of the spit are the ones nobody has had a reason to reach. Take water. The walk back is the same walk.

tan_gad_salvage.accept_text:
The scrapjaws nest in the good buildings, which is also where the good brass is, which means my suppliers and my competition are the same animal.

Bring me fittings and pages. The pages are for Hesper - she pays better for paper than I do for brass, which tells you something about this town that I find hard to look at directly.

All of it is in the Gadgetzan Ruins, west of the port. The scavengers pick over the same streets.

tan_zf_the_offer.accept_text:
I am not going to pretend this is a peace mission. You are going to have to go through a great many of them to stand anywhere a hexxer will hear you, and ten is my estimate and I am probably low.

Bring me their fetishes, and come back and tell me what you make of it, because I would like one person in this town to have an opinion they arrived at by looking.

They are at Zul'Farrak Ruins, west across the whole desert. Nobody from this town has walked it to ask.

tan_cove_two_went_down.accept_text:
I buy off Vaile's people. I am not proud of it and I am not going to lie about it to you of all people.

What I will tell you is that the ones who come up to trade will haggle about anything in that cove except the bottom chamber, and they do not refuse, they just go quiet.

Bring me shells off the bilge crawlers, and the bosuns' whistles. The whistles are how they call each other down there and I want to know if there is a call for the bottom.

tan_cove_the_warden.accept_text:
A careenage. They haul a hull over on that ground to work the bottom of it, which means that cove was a WORKING YARD before it was a pirate hole, and a working yard has a watchman.

Bring me their whistles and focuses. I am not asking you to go to the careenage yet. I am asking you to take the cove's middle off its feet first, because whatever is on that ground, you do not want it and Vaile's crew behind you at once.

The Drownbell cove, south-west of our gate. You know the shore by now.

tan_cove_whose_claim.accept_text:
Before Vaile's crew there was a working party in that cove with a diving bell and a winch and a claim in order. Then there was not.

Bring me tallies off the shore, and the crawler shells - the crawlers are all over the lower cove and they are eating something down there, and I would like to know whether it is fish.

The cove is the Drownbell, south-west of the port gate.

tan_berth_done.accept_text:
Walk the new front, end to end, and tell me if it reads as one quay or as two.

Then go and finish what started this. Bring me more off the shore, and the bosuns' whistles - they signal with them and I would like to know the calls, because a harbour that can read the signals outside the heads is a harbour that gets a night's sleep.

The shore I mean is the Drownbell cove, south-west of the port gate.

tan_solo_salt_air.turn_in_text:
These cores are a season of mornings I do not have to pump for.

And before you ask - no, I will not temper you something that does both. Anybody who tells you they can is selling you a story. Pick the sea or pick the sand and I will do it properly.

ucq_kolven_ledger.turn_in_text:
These are the pages.

So it isn't one of mine.

Pity. I'd have enjoyed the argument, and I'd have won it.

ucq_pd_sump.accept_text: The Plague Depths, through the iron door at the south end of the wheel. The Outer Cistern is the first of it. Plague Spores and Rot Worms. Bring the vials back with the stoppers on. If you drop one, don't tell me.

ucq_pd_ledger.accept_text: Below the city, in the Plague Depths - the iron door is at the south end of the wheel. The Court of Rot is its north-west wing. The Blighted Courtiers. Bring me any ledgers you find, whatever state they're in. I can read through a stain.

ud_shard_crates.accept_text:
Bring me cores, and take them out of the lattice sentries rather than off the ground. Ground stock is half shell and the Reagent-Keeper sends it back with a note.

The sentries will let you walk out there. They object when you start cutting. There is no way to do this politely and I have stopped looking for one.

ud_lattice_repeats.accept_text:
Go after the sentries, and I want them taken apart rather than simply dropped. Cut them where the figure closes - you will see it, there is a seam in the pattern and it is always in the same place relative to the body.

If it is always in the same place on all of them, that is not mineralisation. That is a design, and designs have designers, and I will put THAT in a report whatever the Codex rules.

ud_archive_unissued.turn_in_text:
These slips have numbers all ahead of my sequence, and before you ask me whose hand it is - yes. I recognise it.

I am not going to say. Not until I have been down to the Bloom myself, and I have been putting that off for eleven months.

ud_bloom_argument.accept_text:
Bring me husks from the Reach, and the thread they are strung on, and I want the thread live - cut it and bag it before it dries.

I am going to tell you what I am going to do with it, because the Codex-Master will not. I am going to show it to the Hall and I am going to point out that it runs from the Reach to the Bastion's own cellars, and then I am going to ask her again about the burning, and she is going to say no again.

arw_the_gap.turn_in_text:
I've got the slips, and all of them agree with my book.

Eighteen months I have been doing this and it turns out I have been doing it correctly. I did not expect that to feel like anything. It does.

arw_the_overseer.turn_in_text:
You got the leaves, and the house is in uproar. Good.

The farmers get to keep farming either way, which was never going to change and was never the point. The point is that somebody in Alterac now has to explain a gap in the accounts. Let them.

are_six_wrecks.turn_in_text:
These tins have manifests in them, and three of them are the same cargo consigned to the same buyer.

These ships were not blown onto these rocks. They were coming here. Somebody was running a route into this archipelago and the route ate them.
